warnings: Budget Tier Preference Tip: Alice prefers Tier 2 (moderate) while Bob prefers Tier 3 (higher budget). The itinerary achieves an optimal compromise by utilizing high-value boutique accommodations (Hotel Gracery Shinjuku and Cross Hotel Kyoto), well-priced artisan culinary spots with dedicated allergy safeguards, and premium cultural experiences (such as Shigetsu Shojin Ryori and Shibuya Sky).

Morning Routine Preference Tip: Alice prefers early starts (6:00 AM–8:00 AM) while Bob prefers later mornings (10:00 AM–12:00 PM). The itinerary includes split parallel morning branches on Day 2 and Day 6, allowing Alice to experience peaceful early-morning cultural photography (Meiji Jingu, Fushimi Inari) while Bob enjoys restful sleep-ins and leisurely mornings before reuniting mid-morning.

Shopping & Pacing Balance Tip: Bob enjoys shopping and a more relaxed travel pace, whereas Alice is non-shopping focused and prefers an active pace. Dedicated splits in Harajuku (Day 2) and Arashiyama (Day 7) give Bob time to browse boutiques while Alice explores cultural museums and nature paths, followed by shared relaxing downtime every afternoon.
